blocks.text: Is section (hisse) mein hum dekhenge ke modern agriculture (aaj kal ki kheti baari) mein chemistry ka kya role (kirdar) hai. Duniya ki aabadi barh rahi hai, is liye food (khuraak) ki demand (maang) bhi barh rahi hai. Is maang ko poora karne ke liye fertilizers (khaad), pesticides (keeron aur bimariyon ko maarne wali dawaiyan) aur genetic engineering ki ahmiyat aur kirdar par baat hogi. Yeh hissa yeh bhi batayega ke acid rain (tezabi barish) fasalon aur mitti par kaun se chemical reactions karti hai, aur climate change (mausam ki tabdeeli) crop growth (fasalon ki barhotri) par kaise asar dalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen tareeqe batayein jin se chemistry khuraak ki paidawar barhati hai.
blocks.explanation: Fertilizers, pesticides aur fasalon ki genetic engineering.

items: Agriculture mein chemistry: fertilizers, pesticides, genetic engineering.
Acid rain ke reactions aur climate change ka fasalon par asar bhi.
